items.title: Bitmine adds 9,926 ETH, taking total holdings to roughly $11 billion
items.summary: Bitmine added 9,926 ETH last week, taking holdings to 5.82 million tokens while buybacks reached 20.8 million shares since July.

items.title: No change in bitcoin holdings as Strategy boosted dollar reserve, bought back more STRC last week
items.summary: Led by Executive Chairman Michael Saylor, the company raised $333.7 million via the sale of common stock.

items.title: Strategy sells $334 million in MSTR shares, makes no bitcoin purchases or sales as USD reserve hits $4.8 billion
items.summary: Strategy's total holdings account for around 4% of the 21 million bitcoin supply cap — worth roughly $53.4 billion.

items.title: Paul Tudor Jones' Firm Buys Back Into BlackRock Bitcoin ETF After a Year of Selling
items.summary: The macro fund raised its iShares Bitcoin Trust stake 18.9% to 688,529 shares worth $22.9 million in Q2, while sharply cutting its call options—a shift from leveraged bets toward direct spot exposure.
